caption:
Gratitude: do not forget to thank the people around you.

The Prophet ﷺ said that the one who does not thank people is not thankful to Allah. A simple thank you is part of your gratitude.

Sunan Abi Dawud 4811 · Grade: Sahih

Send this to someone you never properly thanked.

#hadithreels #gratitude #thankyou #shukr
